d: Capital / HQ / Research Era / Research Economy / Worker upgrades / resource drop-off / Supply generation / Objective

The capital - the Shelter in Age 0, the Fortress from age-up. Every player starts the match with one and never has another. Only siege with a large army behind it brings it down; it leaves rubble, and a player whose Fortress is not rebuilt on that rubble in time is out of the match. Trains Workers and Scouts (and, for Alanthor, the Ledger and King Lexor), hosts the capital's research, and LOCKS its territory so no army can take it while it stands.
